settings_ui_language_desc: By default, the interface uses your translation target language.
settings_general_desc: Choose your languages, default translation engine, and display preferences.
settings_default_provider_desc: Used unless you choose another engine for a translation.
settings_skip_langs_desc: Skip text in these languages. Text in your target language is always skipped.
settings_detector_ready: Ready. Detects text in your target language and excluded languages so it can be skipped before translation.
settings_detector_unavailable: Unavailable in this browser. Uses writing-system detection and checks for unchanged translations instead.
settings_detector_downloadable: Download a small local model to better identify text that does not need translation.
settings_input_desc: After typing in a supported text field, press Space {count} times in a row to replace your text with its translation.
settings_input_hint_3: to choose the target language for this translation only.
settings_input_target_desc: Choose a language for writing. This can differ from your reading language.
settings_style_desc: Choose how translations look on the page. By default, they match the page. Select a preview to apply it.
provider_section_desc: Use the built-in free engine or connect an AI service with your own API key. Compatible local services may work without a key.
provider_models_failed: Couldn't fetch the model list — check your network or API key
provider_remove_confirm_text: This removes the engine and its API key.
provider_free_desc: Free, no API key needed. The built-in fallback engine.
provider_base_url_insecure: Use an https:// URL — http:// only works for localhost.
provider_headers_desc: One per line, as Header-Name: value
provider_params_desc: Leave fields blank to use the model defaults. Supported parameters depend on the model; some reasoning models use a fixed temperature.
provider_param_max_tokens_desc: A low limit may cut off translations, especially when translating a page in batches.
provider_param_reasoning_desc: Behavior depends on the model and service. For Gemini and some models that require reasoning, Off reduces reasoning or leaves it enabled. Validate the connection after changing this setting.
provider_validate_hint_model: Set a model, then validate to enable.
site_section_desc: Choose a default translation behavior and add rules for individual sites.
backup_section_desc: Export your settings (API keys included) to a JSON file, or restore from one.
backup_reset_confirm_text: This resets all settings and removes your added engines, API keys, site rules, custom styles, and glossaries. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.
backup_imported: Settings imported. Validate the imported AI engines before enabling them. The built-in free engine does not require validation.
options_tagline: AI translation for thoughtful reading · Settings
panel_input_placeholder: Type or paste text to translate…
panel_swap_disabled: Choose a source language before swapping.
input_failed: Translation failed. Your original text has been kept.
error_no_key: This engine is missing an API key. Please add one in settings.
error_timeout: The engine took too long to respond. Please try again later.
error_interrupted: Translation was interrupted. Please try again.
error_network: Network connection failed. Please check your connection and retry.
error_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_unavailable: The translation service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
styles_section_desc: Shape tone, register, and word choice with natural language — the active style applies to page, selection, and input translation alike.
style_builtin_colloquial_desc: Natural, conversational wording and short sentences, without stiff literal translations.
style_builtin_academic_desc: Formal language and precise terminology, preserving the original qualifications and uncertainty.
style_builtin_technical_desc: Keep API names and identifiers unchanged, use clear instructions, and maintain consistent terminology.
style_builtin_literary_desc: Preserve the original voice, rhythm, and imagery with flexible phrasing.
styles_directives_hint: Describe the tone and wording you want. Focus on style; output-format instructions are added automatically.
expert_desc: Customize the full prompt templates, for example by adding translation examples. Custom templates replace the style instructions for the corresponding translation mode.
expert_batch_system_label: Whole-page batch · system template (must keep the [[{salt}#N]] marker instruction)
expert_placeholders_hint: Placeholders: {target} target language · {source} source language · {title} page title · {text} the text (user template only) · {salt} batch marker salt (batch template only)
expert_error_batch_marker: Keep the exact fragment [[{salt}# in the batch template. It is required to match each translation to its source text.
expert_error_single_text: Include {text} in the user template so the text to translate is sent to the engine.
styles_rules_desc: Assign styles to specific sites. The longest matching site pattern takes priority; otherwise, your default style applies.
glossary_section_desc: Specify preferred translations for terms. Only entries matching the source text are added to AI prompts; unused entries add no tokens. You can limit each set to specific sites using the same patterns as site rules.
glossary_pattern_label: Site pattern (optional; blank applies to all sites)
glossary_import_err_empty: No usable term rows in the file — it needs source/target columns (CSV/TSV) or the matching JSON fields.
glossary_import_err_unrecognized: Could not parse the file — supported: an exported JSON set, or CSV/TSV rows of source,target[,note].
settings_page_context_desc: Before translating, send up to the first 8,000 characters of page text, including content outside the viewport, to the AI engine for context. This helps keep names and terminology consistent and adds one request per page. AI engines only.
settings_rich_text_desc: Keep links, bold text, and inline code in translations. If formatting affects translation quality, turn this off to use plain text.
interleave_desc: Place each translated paragraph right after its source paragraph in multi-paragraph blocks
provider_quick_add_desc: Connect AI providers or local and cloud services compatible with OpenAI or Anthropic.
backup_drop_label: Choose a JSON backup or drop it here
backup_drop_hint: Supports interline-config.json backups from older versions or other devices.
provider_reasoning_required_desc: This model requires reasoning. This switch cannot turn it off.
provider_temperature_fixed_desc: This model uses a fixed sampling temperature. Custom temperature settings are ignored.
glossary_empty_hint: Create a glossary, import a CSV/TSV/JSON file, or choose an English-to-Simplified-Chinese preset below.
